title: efs-fixture-lease/1 — one instance in the machine-wide fixture registry (tools/fixture-registry.mjs)
description: A stable contract shared by the contracts fixture, the SDK and the client supervisor: readers must check `schema` and ignore fields they do not know; a breaking change gets a new schema id. <home>/leases/<name>.json, created with open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) and replaced only by its holder (write + rename). The holder is the process (pid, startTime[, command]) as `ps -o lstart= -o command=` reports it under LC_ALL=C; a lease whose holder no longer matches on this host is stale. Kinds: chain (tools/efs-fixture.mjs), gateway and ui (the client supervisor). Times are ISO 8601 UTC.

state.description: chain: allocating → allocated → deploying → verifying → ready (or failed, kept by up --keep-on-fail); other kinds choose their own

generation.description: 1 on first up; reset increments it

pid.description: the process holding the lease (a chain: its anvil, once spawned)

startTime.description: the holder's start time, ps lstart format

command.description: the holder's command line; down signals a chain's pid only when it equals this and names anvil --port <port>

owner.description: the process that created the lease (informational)

hostname.description: os.hostname() of the holder; a lease from another host is never judged or broken

expiresAt.description: startedAt + ttl; the chain's watchdog kills anvil then

checkout.description: the repository root of the tool that started the instance

artifacts.description: the identity build the plan was computed from (EFS_ARTIFACTS_DIR)

plan.description: the deploy/plan.json the computed plan was required to equal (up --plan), or null

unlocked.description: requested: anvil's default accounts unlocked (true) or --no-unlocked (false)

signerCapable.description: measured at up: eth_accounts is non-empty

deployment.description: path of the instance's efs-deployment/1 document

seed.description: folder {name, directoryRecordId, subjectId}; file {name, subjectId, headRecordId, headRevision}

verified.description: the in-up verify: {skipped} or {skipped false, ok, checks, failures, ms, coldPin}
